drawPhase: Draw a card from the stock or discard pile
playPhase: Meld or lay off, then discard one card

hint.drawFromDiscard: Draw from the discard pile — it fits your hand
hint.meld: You can lay down a meld — select and play it
hint.discard: Discard a card you don't need

candidates.title: Meld candidates
candidates.hint: Tap a candidate to select those cards. Cards with a yellow ring can be laid off.

tutorial.drawArea: Draw a card from the stock or discard pile to start your turn.
tutorial.playerHand: This is your hand. Form sets or ropes (runs) of 3+ cards.
tutorial.meldArea: Select 3+ cards and press Meld to lay them down. Lay off single cards onto existing melds.
tutorial.discardButton: Discard one card to end your turn.
tutorial.scoreTable: Each player's chips and scores are shown here.
tutorial.resetButton: Press the reset button to start a new game.
